categories.description: A legacy proposal or plan outranks runtime, release authority, canon, or an owner decision.
A present-tense story claim does not match reachable runtime or current copy.
A plot turn lacks an intelligible desire, obstacle, action, consequence, setup, or payoff.
A character acts as a theme-delivery device rather than from a legible and evolving drive.
A forced rite, timeout, fallback, or rescue is presented as genuine player choice or earned action.
Author-only truth, later identity, or open ontology reaches the player too clearly or too early.
Ambiguity is asserted without concrete, interpretable player evidence.
Musical motif, harmony, or release does not set up, transform, or pay off the story's emotional causality.
Shot, lens, palette, camera, or rendering change annotates spectacle instead of carrying story meaning.
A candidate resolves the Makers, Terra authorship, simulation, third-consciousness mapping, or final frame without owner authority.
An older document still claims current production, next-build, or in-flight authority after supersession.
Beat IDs, source paths, status vocabulary, links, or the machine authority manifest disagree.
A material peer objection or taste thesis was ignored, self-closed, or flattened.
A planning commission mutates shipped story, protected audio, or post-arrival runtime while the demo lock is active.
